title: Sportmodular Course Grey

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Engineered for adaptable touring, the AGV Sportmodular Course Grey is combines flip-up modular convenience with highway touring comfort across highway and urban riding. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1305g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~86 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Modular convenience with full carbon fiber construction.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Standard AGV fit; slightly narrow at the temples compared to round ovals, requires cheek pads adjustment for long heads. Designed for Intermediate Oval head shape.

technical_analysis: Features 100% 3K Carbon Fiber shell construction developed under AGV Extreme Safety protocol for MotoGP performance paired with Class-1 optical Ultravision shield offering 190° horizontal and 85° vertical field of view. The interior utilizes 360° Adaptive Fit crown structure with 2Dry moisture-wicking Shalimar & Ritmo fabric lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the AGV Sportmodular Course Grey: combining Italy 🇮🇹 craftsmanship with Class-1 optical Ultravision shield offering 190° horizontal and 85° vertical field of view and 360° Adaptive Fit crown structure with 2Dry moisture-wicking Shalimar & Ritmo fabric lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: AGV Sportmodular Course Grey: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the AGV Sportmodular Course Grey. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in AGV's Modular lineup, the Sportmodular Course Grey brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The AGV Sportmodular Course Grey represents AGV's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~86 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the AGV Sportmodular Course Grey delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
